stories.headline: Glacial collapse kills at least 160 near Nepal-China border
stories.body: Flash floods left hundreds missing and damaged roads, bridges, villages and hydropower facilities along the Nepal-Tibet border.

stories.headline: FDA approves multi-RAS therapy for metastatic pancreatic cancer
stories.body: Certain adults with previously treated metastatic pancreatic cancer now have an approved therapy targeting multiple RAS proteins.

stories.headline: U.S. disables platforms used by Chinese state-sponsored hackers
stories.body: Federal seizures made QScan and QTRouter inoperable, disrupting tools used to conceal intrusions into U.S. agencies and critical infrastructure.

stories.headline: Judge allows federal mail-ballot restrictions to take effect
stories.body: The Postal Service can implement new mailed-voting rules before the midterms after the injunction was lifted.
